resources.string: A private mood journal that stays on this phone. First, pick a language: the starter moods and tags are written in it.
More languages are on the way.
Start from a backup instead of from scratch. Its entries, moods and tags take the place of the starter content.
From another phone or an earlier install. Everything comes back as it was, photos, habits and settings included.
Bring your entries, photos, moods and tags along from a .daylio backup.
Open Daylio\'s backup screen, export a backup and pick Dakilio in the share menu. It comes straight back here.
I already have a backup file
Tags note what your day was made of. Keep the groups that fit your life.
Tap a group to leave it out. You can add, rename or remove tags any time in More → Tags.
